# HP Canada

> HP Canada is the official HP site for laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, support, software, and business technology solutions.

HP Canada combines consumer and business computing, printing, collaboration, and services across shopping, product information, support, drivers, and enterprise solutions. This guide prioritizes durable product, support, and solution pages on hp.com.

## Main Site
- [HP Canada Home](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/home.html): Official HP Canada homepage for PCs, printers, supplies, and support.
- [HP Store Canada](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop): HP Canada online store for computers, printers, monitors, and accessories.
- [Weekly Deals](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/weekly-deals): Current HP Canada promotions across laptops, desktops, printers, and accessories.
- [Support Home](https://support.hp.com/ca-en): Central support portal for troubleshooting, drivers, manuals, and diagnostics.
- [Business Solutions](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/business.html): Overview of HP business devices, services, security, and workplace solutions.
- [Printers Home](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/printers/home-printers.html): Entry point for home printing products, plans, and printer categories.

## Laptops & Mobile PCs
- [Laptop Deals](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/weekly-deals?tab=1): Discounted HP laptops and notebook offers in the Canada store.
- [Laptops for Home](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/laptops?segment=home): Consumer laptop listings for everyday use, school, and entertainment.
- [Laptops for Work](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/laptops?segment=business): Business laptop catalog including ProBook, EliteBook, and enterprise-ready models.
- [Mobile Workstations](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/laptops?formfactor=mobile-workstations): Portable HP Z workstations for creators, engineers, and technical workflows.
- [Laptops for Gaming](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/laptops?segment=gaming): Gaming laptop lineup including OMEN and Victus systems.
- [OmniBook Laptops](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/sitesearch?keyword=OmniBook): Search results for HP OmniBook consumer laptop models.
- [EliteBook Laptops](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/sitesearch?keyword=EliteBook): Search results for HP EliteBook business laptop models.

## Desktops, Workstations & Displays
- [Desktop Deals](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/weekly-deals?tab=2): Discounted desktop PCs and all-in-one offers in the Canada store.
- [Desktops for Home](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/desktops?segment=home): Consumer desktop PCs for home productivity and entertainment.
- [Desktops for Work](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/desktops?segment=business): Business desktop catalog for office, manageability, and security needs.
- [Workstations](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/desktops?subbrand=z-workstation): HP Z desktop workstations for professional graphics and compute workloads.
- [Desktops for Gaming](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/desktops?segment=gaming): Gaming desktops including OMEN and Victus configurations.
- [Monitors](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/monitors): HP monitor catalog for home, business, and gaming displays.
- [All Desktops](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/desktops): Full desktop and all-in-one product listings.

## AI PCs & Advanced Computing

- [Microsoft Copilot+ PCs for Business](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/software/microsoft-copilot-pcs-for-business.html): HP business PCs designed for Copilot+ PC experiences and AI workflows.

- [Workstations](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/workstations.html): HP workstation portfolio for AI, data science, design, and engineering.
- [Z Workstation Software & Solutions](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/workstations/software-solutions-workstation-pc.html): Software and workflow tools for HP Z workstations and remote collaboration.

## Printers, Ink & Scanning
- [Printer Deals](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/weekly-deals?tab=4): Discounted printers and print-related offers in the Canada store.
- [Home Printers](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/printers/home-printers.html): HP home printer categories, buying guidance, and product families.
- [Business Printers](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/printers/business-printers.html): HP business printer portfolio for office and managed print needs.
- [Scanners](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/printers?prodtype=flatbed): Flatbed scanner listings in the HP Canada store.
- [Ink, Toner & Paper](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/ink--toner---paper): Supplies catalog for original HP ink, toner, and paper.
- [Large Format Printers](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/printers/large-format.html): HP large-format printers and plotters for technical and graphics printing.
- [Printer Support](https://support.hp.com/ca-en/printers): Support resources for HP printers, setup, troubleshooting, and drivers.

## Instant Ink & Subscription Services
- [HP Instant Ink](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/printers/instant-ink.html): Ink and toner subscription service with automatic delivery and recycling.
- [Instant Ink Sign In](https://instantink.hpconnected.com/ca/en/l): Account portal for managing HP Instant Ink subscriptions.
- [HP All-In Plan](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/all-in-plan/printers.html): Printer subscription plans bundling hardware, ink, and support.
- [HP Smart](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/printers/hp-smart-app.html): HP Smart app for printer setup, scanning, and mobile print management.

## Support, Drivers & Troubleshooting
- [HP Support](https://support.hp.com/ca-en): Main support portal for products, diagnostics, and help articles.
- [Software and Drivers](https://support.hp.com/ca-en/drivers): Download drivers, firmware, and software for HP devices.
- [Printer Support](https://support.hp.com/ca-en/printers): Troubleshooting, setup, and driver resources for HP printers.
- [Computer Support](https://support.hp.com/ca-en/computers): Support resources for HP laptops, desktops, and workstations.
- [Product Warranty Check](https://support.hp.com/ca-en/check-warranty): Check warranty status for HP products by serial number.
- [Contact HP Support](https://support.hp.com/ca-en/contact): Contact options for HP customer and technical support.
- [HP Support Assistant](https://support.hp.com/ca-en/help/hp-support-assistant): HP utility for updates, diagnostics, and device maintenance.

- [HP Wolf Security](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/security/endpoint-security-solutions.html): Endpoint security solutions for protecting PCs, printers, and users.
- [HP Smart](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/printers/hp-smart-app.html): Printing and scanning software for home and office workflows.
- [Poly Lens](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/poly/software-and-services/poly-lens.html): Device management platform for Poly collaboration hardware and peripherals.
- [Workforce Experience Platform](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/services/workforce-experience-platform.html): HP platform for digital employee experience and IT insights.

- [HP Poly](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/poly.html): Collaboration devices and solutions for meetings, audio, and video.

- [Workstations](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/workstations.html): Professional workstation systems for technical and creative teams.

## Accessories & Peripherals
- [Monitors](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/monitors): Displays for productivity, conferencing, and gaming setups.
- [Accessories](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/accessories): HP accessories including docks, keyboards, mice, and adapters.
- [Ink, Toner & Paper](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/ink--toner---paper): Original HP print supplies and media for supported printers.
- [Scanners](https://www.hp.com/ca-en/shop/listings/printers?prodtype=flatbed): Scanner products for document capture and office workflows.
- [HyperX](https://hyperx.com): HP gaming peripherals and audio brand for players and streamers.
